refresh: Yearly, after J.P. Morgan publishes its Long-Term Capital Market Assumptions (October) and Vanguard its economic and market outlook (December).
method: Nominal 10-15 year forecasts. 'geometric' is the compound annual return: an equal blend of J.P. Morgan 2027 LTCMA and the midpoint of Vanguard's 2026 10-year range, rounded. 'arithmetic' (what the engine draws) = geometric + volatility^2 / 2. Volatilities are long-run planning figures.
sources: J.P. Morgan 2027 Long-Term Capital Market Assumptions (Oct 2026): US large cap 7.5%, global aggregate bonds 5.3%, 60/40 7.0%. https://am.jpmorgan.com/us/en/asset-management/institutional/about-us/media/press-releases/jp-morgan-releases-2027-long-term-capital-market-assumptions/

Vanguard economic and market outlook for 2026 (Dec 2025): US equities 4.0-5.0%, ex-US equities 4.9-6.9%, US bonds 3.8-4.8%. https://corporate.vanguard.com/content/corporatesite/us/en/corp/vemo/vemo-return-forecasts.html
